summary.text: Dontavius Jarrells is a Democratic state representative from Ohio who represents District 1 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Dontavius Jarrells was born in Cleveland, Ohio, and graduated from East Technical High School in 2006.
According to Ballotpedia, his career experience includes work as health equity policy and program lead with OhioMHAS and as chief of communications with the Franklin County Treasurer's Office.
Jarrells assumed office in the Ohio House on January 1, 2023, and won the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary over Christopher Robbins.
Ballotpedia lists him as ranking member of the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism Committee.
In the general election he faces Republican Joel A. Greff.
